questions.q: How many degrees are there in a straight angle?
questions.explanation: A straight angle forms a straight line and measures 180°.

questions.q: An angle that measures less than 90° is called ____.
An angle of 135° is a(n) ____ angle.
How many right angles make one complete turn?
Two lines in a plane that never meet, however far extended, are called ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Parallel lines always stay the same distance apart and never meet.

questions.q: How many end points does a ray have?
questions.explanation: A ray starts at one point and goes on endlessly in one direction.
